title: Dia-Lingle: A Gamified Interface for Dialectal Data Collection

bias_targets.methodology: The paper addresses language standard bias and dialectal underrepresentation (representation bias) by developing and evaluating a gamified interface (Dia-Lingle) designed to crowd-source dialectal data, map regional linguistic variations, and train dialect identification classifiers.

Evaluating the risk of cultural marginalization and erasure in AI models by measuring user engagement and usability of a tool built to collect linguistically and culturally diverse regional language data.
